name: external_peg_nominal_ppo_v5_official_fair_baseline
supersession_reason: A source audit found that V4 copied the older examples.sh wall-time command rather than the pinned baselines.sh fair-comparison command. V5 follows the latter exactly for task, seeds, rollout geometry, discounting, update schedule, and transition budget.

source_baseline.official_command: PegInsertionSide-v1; seeds 9351,4796,1788; 2048 envs; 8 update epochs; 32 minibatches; gamma 0.97; gae_lambda 0.95; 75M transitions; 16-step rollouts; 100-step evaluation; 16 evaluation envs
source_baseline.implementation_difference: Readable ppo.py-style checkpoint/resume trainer without CUDA graphs. This preregistration was later rejected because its inherited policy log-standard-deviation initialization and target-KL ordering did not match the ppo_fast.py implementation invoked by baselines.sh.

claim_boundary: This establishes only a shared nominal controller and exact fair-baseline transfer. It cannot release specialist/router claims without the independent competence gate.
